name: Zumpo/Room row
description: One room in a lobby list. Details: the host plus the game setting (rounds or board); a room that kept its default name, "Maya’s room", shows only the setting, since the name says who hosts. Open and Private rooms show Join (Private adds a lock and asks for the password next); Full and Playing rooms show their state instead, because they cannot be joined, and Watch beside it while a spectator seat is free. On a desktop the action column is 168 px, as wide as Playing beside Watch, so the player counts of a list line up.
